brief: Attempt 5. (1) Audio fix: whoosh 0.065 -> ~0.25 at both boundaries; re-level bed to -14 LUFS integrated (loudnorm on finished mix approved); add a mid-weight cue into the changes scene. (2) Extend the accent into the hook (f005-f085). (3) Delete a third-party site/business/nate-barbershop from render.json AND scene-manifest.json. (4) Delete the orphaned PromptTypingAudio function. whoosh_asset_normalised.root_cause: send-whoosh.wav peaked at -13.44 dBFS while every other SFX in the library peaks between -0.4 and -2.1 dBFS. At volume 0.25 the old asset contributed only ~+1.6 dB at the boundary — the asset, not the multiplier, was the problem.
whoosh_asset_normalised.fix: Normalised send-whoosh.wav to -6.0 dBFS peak (git-tracked, recoverable). Now at volume 0.25 the whoosh peaks ~9.6 dB above the BG bed RMS.
whoosh_asset_normalised.code: send-whoosh volume 0.065 -> 0.25 at both changesStart (221) and finalStart (451).

change_audio.mid_weight_cue: Added notify-boosted.wav @ changesStart+160 (f381), volume 0.20 — a 0.36s notification ping filling the 2.1s bare-music hold between the highlight sweep (scene-frame 132) and the exit (scene-frame 196). Also lifted the existing sparkle-whoosh covering the highlight sweep from 0.08 -> 0.16 (it was ~14 dB under the bed and inaudible).
change_audio.master_chain: Raw render measured I=-29.6 LUFS, peak -11.76 dBFS -> crest/loudness ratio 17.8 dB. A single linear loudnorm to -14 LUFS needs +15.8 dB of gain, which pushed the whoosh/bed summit to +2.1 dBFS true peak = hard clipping. FIX: alimiter (limit=-18 dBFS) -> acompressor (threshold=-16, ratio=4, makeup=1) -> loudnorm(I=-14, TP=-1.5, linear, measured values from pass 1). Result I=-13.8 LUFS, TP=-1.4 dBFS (no clip), LRA 5.1 LU. Note: the in-code comment claiming the bed 'is loudnorm-processed to -14 LUFS' was corrected to state the master happens post-render.

change_hook_accent.problem: The only accent in the title scene was the 'App Store' span, which rides inside secondIn and does not even begin to fade up until f74; by f85 it is only ~29% opaque. So the entire 0-2.83s hook measured 0 accent px (attempt 4 finding).
change_hook_accent.fix: Accented the brand name 'RankPal' in the headline line-1 (fades in at f12), and added a 5px accent rule with a glow that wipes in at f34-60 under the headline. The 'App Store' accent span already in secondIn now stacks on top from f74.
change_hook_accent.pixel_proof: accent px (rgb(14,165,233)): f014=0 (headline not yet in), f030=1,051 (0.05%), f050=4,583 (0.22%), f070=4,640 (0.22%), f085=4,638 (0.22%). Brand colour now on screen from ~f30, inside the most-watched 2.8s.

Cue onsets (peak-dB envelope vs local baseline): whoosh f221 +8.0 dB, mid cue f381 +3.1 dB, whoosh f451 +3.5 dB — all clearly audible. No voiceover by design; scored on mix loudness, cue clarity, and absence of clipping.

verdict_reason: All 8 dimensions at or above the 4/5 floor (7 scored at 5/5, subtitle n/a). Every item in the attempt-5 brief is done and verified: whoosh re-leveled and audible at both boundaries (+8.0/+3.5 dB), bed re-leveled to -13.8 LUFS with no clipping, mid-weight cue added (+3.1 dB), accent extended into the hook (0->4,638 px at f30-f85), a third-party site string deleted from all three loaded/spec JSONs (0 OCR matches), and PromptTypingAudio removed (tsc clean). No global blockers. Per the gate, a clean pass on all eight dimensions means the harness is validated end-to-end — ship it.
